modmenu.descriptionTranslation.minegit: GitHub көче кулланган Minecraft болыттагы саклау системасы!
minegit.link.title: MineGit болыт синхронлаштыру көйләүләре
minegit.link.status.error.generic: When trying to test your credentials нәрсәдер ялгыш китте! (%s санлы хата)
minegit.sync.enable.title: Болыт синхронлаштыруны кушу
minegit.sync.enable.confirm.line2: Бу дөнья өчен яңа GitHub repository ясалачак.
minegit.sync.enable.create_repo.error: While creating the GitHub repo нәрсәдер ялгыш китте! (%s хата)
minegit.sync.enable.git_init.error: While setting up the Git repo нәрсәдер ялгыш китте!
minegit.sync.pull_unreachable.title: Болыт синхронлаштыру хатасы
minegit.sync.pull_unreachable.descriptio: Your latest world changes could not be synced with the cloud. You can continue to load the world if you wish, but you might not have the latest version of your world.
minegit.sync.push_unreachable.title: Болыт синхронлаштыру хатасы
minegit.sync.push_unreachable.descriptio: Your latest world changes could not be synced with the cloud. Make sure you're not offline and then try again.
minegit.sync.conflict.title: Болыт синхронлаштыру хатасы
minegit.sync.conflict.description: The version of the world saved on your device conflicts with the one saved in the cloud. Whichever world data you choose to keep will be synced to this device and the cloud; the other will be overwritten.
minegit.sync.conflict.failed: Resolving sync conflict failed. You may need to delete the world and re-clone.
minegit.clone.title: Дөньяны күчермәләү
minegit.clone.error.generic: Дөньяны күчермәләп караганда нәрсәдер ялгыш китте.
minegit.prune.title: Дөнья кәмитләрен кисү
minegit.prune.description: This will delete all but the most recent version of your world both locally and from cloud storage. You will no longer be able to restore old snapshots of your world, but it will reduce the world's file size.
minegit.prune.failed: Дөньяны кисеп булмады. Please see game console for details
